messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty CRITICAL -> p99 latency SLO burn on /chat.stream (eu-west). p95 jumped from 1.1s -> 2.3s, p99 from 2.8s -> 6.1s. SLO burn: 78%. Pager: PD#INC-5782

alice: acked on PD and taking lead. I'm oncall for the next 2h. Starting triage.

ben: looking at traces — spike right after request enter; spans show high `tokenizer.init` and `tokenizer.rpc` times. Not seeing large batch sizes.

carmen: customer-impact: multiple chat sessions timing out/replying slowly for prompt templates that do heavy pre-tokenization (long system + user). Support ticket with orgs A & B created.

ben: quick snippet from trace heatmap (recent 5m):
```
[tokenizer.init]  p50=12ms p95=180ms p99=510ms
[tokenizer.rpc]   p50=7ms  p95=420ms p99=2100ms <-- big outlier
[model.decode]    p50=30ms p95=90ms  p99=200ms
```

alice: interesting — tokenizer.rpc is to an internal service (tokenizer-svc) that lives on ECS in same region. Could be a cold start or connection churn. Can someone check tokenizer-svc autoscaling and recent deploys?

ben: checking ECS tasks now. No deployments in the window. CPU and mem look normal, but I see sporadic `ENOTCONN` errors in tokenizer logs around 03:12:xx UTC. Also see long GC pauses on one task that restarted at 03:12:48.

carmen: Confirming customer-reported symptoms: interactive chat delays + some timeouts (504). Percentage of affected requests ~6% of traffic but concentrated on long-prompt path — higher cost customers affected.

alice: mitigation plan options (short-term):
- route long-prompt requests to `tokenizer-local` sidecar fallback (disable remote rpc) for eu-west traffic
- OR route long-prompt traffic to a smaller model variant with lower tokenization overhead (`gpt-small-compact`) until tokenizer-svc stabilizes
- add temporary request-level retry for tokenizer rpc (1 retry, short backoff)

ben: I can flip routing to prefer sidecar for `/chat.stream` for long prompts. Quick command:
```
# update routing policy to prefer-sidecar for long_prompt route
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/routes/update \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"route":"/chat.stream","selector":"long_prompt","policy":"prefer-sidecar"}'
```

alice: do it, ben. Post here when done. I'll also open a mitigation PR for fallback-to-small-model if needed.

ben: applied routing change at 03:18:52 UTC. Confirmed via logs: route-change event -> `prefer-sidecar` for selector long_prompt.

pagerduty-bot: PD ACK by alice (Oncall). Escalation timer paused.

alice: monitoring metrics: p95 dropped from 2.3s -> 1.05s over next 90s; p99 trending down from 6.1s -> 1.9s. :thumbsup:

carmen: pinged Support to update customers A/B with mitigation and ETA.

ben: digging deeper on tokenizer task that restarted — the task had a transient heap spike due to an unbounded input buffer on certain long-system templates. Patch incoming to limit buffer and add defensive timeouts. Deploying a fix to tokenizer-svc in canary now.

alice: good. Can we keep prefer-sidecar routing for 1 hour, then revert if canary is healthy? Also leave PD incident open for 2h to watch for reoccurence.

ben: canary deploy completed at 03:40:11 UTC with health checks green. No GC spikes observed so far in canary. I'll promote to stable in 10m if green.

pagerduty-bot: PD note: incident acknowledged, status: mitigated -> monitoring.

alice: promoting fix to stable now. After promote I'll start gradual rollback of prefer-sidecar (30% -> 100% revert over 15m) and watch latency.

ben: promote successful at 03:52:00 UTC. No regressions in canary or early stable.

alice: rolling back prefer-sidecar to normal routing: started 03:54:10 UTC (30% revert).

carmen: Support updated customers: A notified, B notified, both saw improved latency after mitigation.

alice: rollback completed 04:08:30 UTC. Final checks: p95=0.98s p99=1.2s in eu-west 5m window. SLO burn dropped to 2%.

alice: final actions logged:
- tokenizer-svc: patched buffer limit + defensive timeouts (deployed stable)
- routing: temporary prefer-sidecar applied 03:18:52 -> 04:08:30 UTC
- follow-up: add alert for tokenizer.rpc p95 > 200ms and add autoscale headroom to tokenizer-svc for sustained spikes

alice: handing off to dan (next oncall) for watch window until 06:00 UTC — please keep PD incident open to auto-close if no recurrence. Key checks: tokenizer svc GC, task restarts, p99 tokenization RPC.

dan: acked takeover. Will watch alerts and notify if anything odd. Thanks team.

incident-bot: Incident thread closed to updates at 04:12:00 UTC (status: resolved -> monitoring).
